verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs show search operators that can be combined to narrow results (gmail-docs-12, gmail-docs-47), filters built straight from search results (gmail-docs-48), and specific operators such as in:snoozed (gmail-docs-50). Search also works offline (gmail-docs-9), and a user reports searching a large archive easily (gmail-comm-8). missing for 10: evidence of search speed, evidence of relevance-ranked results, explicit confirmation of coverage across full mail history, independent hands-on corroboration of precision.
